method: Four added normalized source texts read in full against all 20 prior concept lists; broad lexical/context search across ten prior sources for two new disease cases. Candidate contexts reviewed; judgments are agent-authored, not exhaustive independent gold.

judgments.rationale: AI screening/risk and chronic-pancreatitis context; no explicit required morphological feature combination or head-size diagnostic rule.
Prostate contouring/automation review study, not pancreatic inflammatory or tumor imaging.
TAGS tumor segmentation/evaluation study, not inflammatory-versus-tumor diagnostic imaging features.
Whole-pancreas volume in type 2 diabetes; not pancreatic-head diameter or the required inflammatory differential findings.
CT diameter versus reconstructed tumor volume study; tumor measurement is not organ-head enlargement or an inflammatory diagnostic discriminator.
Cancer-only cohort reports head-lesion size and indirect CT signs; it cannot establish a size-to-disease rule or compare cancer against inflammation.
Interobserver tumor-contour/radiomics variability, not the requested disease features.
Radiomics/EUS/MRI machine-learning differential studies and accuracy figures; does not directly supply the required qualitative feature combination.
Inflammation may alter subregion sizes/model assumptions; no quantified head-disease rule or required discriminating feature combination.
Senescence, atrophy, endocrine/exocrine pathology and age-related diseases; not a head-enlargement rule or the required differential imaging combination.

gap_rechecks.agent_judgment: Duct signs, MRCP and contour irregularities describe imaging; none of the four added reviews specifies including/excluding ducts in a whole-pancreas segmentation mask.
gap_rechecks.scope: Prior ten-source gap judgment plus full normalized text review of the four added sources; bounded corpus absence, not a universal absence claim.

gap_rechecks.agent_judgment: Diagnostic uncertainty, imaging sensitivity/specificity and fibrosis are not calibrated pancreatic boundary-segmentation uncertainty validation. No such validation was identified in the added reviews.
